statement_text: The current package contains evidence-capture, quarantine, adjudication, release-egress, and claim-kernel controls for the Beaver Valley public-only pilot.
It does not import real/anonymized June 2026 exercise evidence and does not make a readiness or unreadiness conclusion.
The public exercise notice and public-meeting schedule are treated as evidence-capture clocks, not proof of performance.
All 60 packet gates remain blocked from public readiness language until real/anonymized evidence is adjudicated and released.
The public-context-to-local-closure leak check returns zero rows.
A packet, receipt, transcript, quote, public statement, or AAR paragraph cannot automatically close readiness.
Allowed language: capture clock, acquisition target, candidate evidence, requires adjudication, claim freeze active, no readiness conclusion.
Forbidden language includes ready, green, passed, closed, safe, sufficient, certified, complete, demonstrated, and reasonable assurance ready.
